market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: Negotiations are active with Witkoff/Kushner working on a 14-point MOU with Iran on sanctions, uranium, and Strait of Hormuz. Sticking points remain on uranium stockpile and ballistic missiles. With ~22 days to May 31 and Iran resisting key US demands, an agreement specifically including oil sanctions relief is plausible but more likely to slip past the deadline.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether final deal includes oil sanctions relief or just framework with later phased lifting
